name: Dietlinde Forgan
original_name: ディートリンデ フォルガン
source:
The granddaughter of the head of the wealthy Forgan family, and the second of three sisters.

She has a strong sense of aristocratic privilege and harbors deeply discriminatory views.
She does not look kindly upon Hayate and the others visiting the mansion for a request.

[b]“Filthy commoners. How revolting.”[/b]
